title: FOMO: FLEX Options and Market Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2610.13044v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: FLEX options are customized exchange-traded contracts allowing participants to choose nonstandard strikes, expirations, exercise styles, and settlement terms while retaining central clearing. We investigate whether single-name FLEX activity leaves measurable footprints in regular listed-option markets and underlying equities. Using a linked dataset of FLEX consolidations, daily open-interest files, listed-option chains, equity returns, and corporate actions over 250 trading days (March 2025-March 2026) across 41 underlyings and 53 event dates, we document three primary empirical findings: (1) Matched-control difference-in-differences estimates reveal a robust post-event increase in listed-option open interest (beta = 0.3061, p = 0.0042, Benjamini-Hochberg p = 0.0168). (2) FLEX activity is strongly selected into high implied-volatility (IV) environments, concentrated in mid-price underlyings (date-fixed-effect ATM IV premium beta = 0.1235

translated_abstract: FLEX期权是定制化的交易所交易合约，允许参与者选择非标准的行权价、到期日、行权方式和结算条款，同时保留中央清算。我们研究单一标的的FLEX期权活动是否会在常规上市期权市场和标的股票中留下可测量的痕迹。利用一个关联数据集——涵盖FLEX合并数据、每日未平仓合约文件、上市期权链、股票回报以及公司行动，跨越250个交易日（2025年3月至2026年3月）、41个标的和53个事件日期，我们记录了三个主要实证发现：（1）匹配对照的双重差分估计显示，事件发生后上市期权未平仓合约出现稳健增加（beta = 0.3061，p = 0.0042，Benjamini-Hochberg校正后 p = 0.0168）。（2）FLEX活动强烈地选择在高隐含波动率（IV）环境中发生，并集中于中等价格水平的标的（日期固定效应平值IV溢价 beta = 0.1235...
tldr: 该研究首次系统性地证实单一标的FLEX期权活动会在常规上市期权市场留下可测量的痕迹，表现为事件后上市期权未平仓合约显著增加，且FLEX交易倾向于集中在高隐含波动率的环境中。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first systematic evidence that single-name FLEX options activity leaves measurable footprints in regular listed-option markets, showing robust post-event increases in listed-option open interest and strong selection into high implied-volatility environments.
